title: digitables
author: irpina
description: M8-style pitch tables: 16 tables of up to 16 semitone steps, with a length and a loop point, saved with the project. Each note restarts its sound's table and the sequencer's clock steps it. The TBL page (AMP's third page, or TABLES in core-dn1's Mod Menu: hold a track key) has TBL, the table per sound and per trig with p-locks, and SPD, the ticks of 24 PPQN a step, or a fraction of a tick down to a step every audio block (MAX, 1500 a second); hold a track key there for the table editor. A step can ADD a note instead: the note keeps playing and a copy of the trig's note starts at the step's offset, released with it (a strummed chord from one trig). Both LFOs can move SPD (DEST AMP:Table Speed), down to the fast end. For OS 1.43 and 1.44; needs core-dn1 3.0.
